Name: Bulk Museum Donations
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This mod adds a little basket to the counter in the museum where you can donate a bunch of artifacts and gemstones all at once. They all get placed down automatically in any available spot, so if you don't care where the items go and you just wanna donate everything you've got, you can use the basket instead of placing them down one by one like you would in the usual donation menu. You will still get all of your rewards, quests, and achievements unlocked.

You can put as many items into the bulk donation menu as it can fit without overflowing the museum. Once it detects that it would fill the museum completely, you will not be allowed to put in any more items (and should consider installing a mod to give you more museum space, which this will be compatible with). You can take items back out of the bulk donation box at any point until you close the menu. After you close the menu, any items left in the bulk donation box will be placed inside the museum and will no longer be retrievable.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=5][b]For Mod Authors[/b][/size][b][size=5]
[/size][/b]You can change where the donation basket is if you want. It just needs the appropriate Tile Action on the buildings layer: "Spiderbuttons.BulkMuseumDonations" That's it, that's the whole action. It will bring up the bulk donation menu. Make sure your map patch overwriting mine has a later priority.
